Project Details

Saffelo is a native Android wallet application and crypto asset monitoring tool, focused on Web3 and Blockchain.

Key Features

Web3 & Blockchain:
Crypto asset monitoring, advice for retail investors, and trading basics for beginners.

Community & Security:
Aggregation of crypto community news, scam alerts, and tips.

Tech Stack

MVVM Kotlin Jetpack Room ViewModel Coroutines Retrofit Dagger Hilt
